record.name: Insight7: AI Speaking Coach
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Ever walk away from a conversation knowing you had more to say, and no idea why it wouldn't come out?

Insight7 is a speaking coach for getting better at talking - with friends, dates, new people, groups, coworkers, or a room full of strangers. Practice conversations out loud, play quick speech games, build a daily speaking habit, and get useful feedback on how you come across. A few minutes at a time, you'll get better at finding your words, thinking on your feet, telling better stories, and feeling more comfortable being heard.

WHAT YOU'LL IMPROVE
Everyday conversation - stop overthinking what to say and get more comfortable just talking
Social confidence - small talk, introductions, dates, parties, new groups, and first impressions
Articulation - find the words you want without getting stuck halfway through a thought
Storytelling - tell stories people actually want to keep listening to
Thinking on your feet - respond in the moment instead of coming up with the perfect answer hours later
Persuasion and empathy - express your point while actually connecting with the person you're talking to
Hard conversations - rehearse the thing you've been avoiding saying
Interviews and meetings - answer clearly, make your point, and stop talking in circles
Public speaking - walk into presentations and speeches having already said it out loud

SPEECH GAMES & DAILY WARM-UP

Not every practice session needs to feel like practice. Start your day with a quick warm-up designed to get your mouth and brain moving. You might keep a story going when the twist changes everything halfway through or think fast when you're given a topic you definitely weren't expecting. Keep your streak going and turn speaking practice into something you actually do every day.

HOW IT WORKS

- Choose a conversation, warm-up, or speaking game
- Speak out loud instead of typing
- Get a real back-and-forth response
- See what worked and what you could improve
- Get feedback on things like clarity, empathy, structure, and persuasion
- Retry difficult moments until they feel natural
- Track your progress as you practice

MEET ROBIN, YOUR AI COACH

Robin is with you before, during, and after every practice session. Use Robin to set up a conversation, talk through something that's been on your mind, figure out why an answer didn't land, or run the same situation again with a different approach.

DISCOVER YOUR COMMUNICATION STYLE

Everyone has a natural way of communicating. Maybe you're a Driver who gets straight to the point. An Expresser who leads with energy. An Analyst who wants the details to make sense. Or a Connector who focuses first on the person in front of them.

Insight7 helps you understand your communication style and learn how to adjust it depending on who you're talking to.

REAL SITUATIONS PEOPLE PRACTICE

- Meeting someone for the first time
- Keeping a conversation going when you don't know what to say next
- Going on a date
- Networking events
- Setting boundaries
- Job interviews
- Asking for a raise
- Giving or receiving feedback
- Speaking up in a meeting
- Presentations and big speeches

WHY PRACTICING OUT LOUD WORKS

You don't get better at conversation by thinking about having conversations. You get better by practicing out loud.

Insight7 gives you a private place to stumble, ramble, retry, and hear yourself improve. So when the real conversation happens, you've already practiced finding the words.

Start with free sessions to experience the app.

Upgrade to Premium for unlimited AI coaching, personalized feedback & scores, session summaries, and full progress tracking.
Premium is available as a weekly ($4.99), monthly ($14.99), or annual ($99) subscription. All plans include a 3-day free trial.

record.offering: Graphics & Design app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
GenAny AI: The All-in-One AI Content Generator
GenAny AI is a powerful, unified application designed to harness the world's most advanced Artificial Intelligence models for both image and video creation. It provides a seamless, professional-grade creative suite within a single, intuitive interface.
Core Features & Capabilities:
Dual-Mode Content Generation:
AI Image Generation:​ Transform text prompts or input images into stunning visuals. Supports both Text-to-Image​ and Image-to-Image​ modes.
AI Video Generation:​ Bring ideas to life as dynamic videos. Supports both Text-to-Video​ and Image-to-Video​ modes, allowing for video creation from descriptive text or by animating uploaded pictures.
Extensive Model Library with Smart Selection:
The app's core is its intelligent Model Selector, a dedicated interface that allows users to choose from a vast catalog of over 20 state-of-the-art AI models, categorized and filtered for ease of use.
For Images:​ Access leading models like Nano Banana​ (Google), GPT-IMAGE-2 .
For Videos:​ Utilize top-tier models including  Veo 3.1​ (Google)
Smart Filtering:​ Models are automatically filtered and presented based on the selected generation mode (image/video) and sub-type (e.g., text-to-video vs. image-to-video), ensuring only relevant options are shown.
Detailed Model Information & Comparison:
Each model card in the selector displays key information to help users make informed choices:
Model Name & Logo​ for clear identification.
Concise Description​ of the model's capabilities and strengths.
User-Centric Interface & Experience:
The Model Selector is presented as a bottom sheet modal, offering a focused, full-screen experience for model selection without leaving the main creation flow.
It includes clear titles, a dedicated close button, and prevents accidental closure by containing tap events within the modal container.
The design uses a dark theme with clear visual hierarchy, making it easy to scan and select from a potentially long list of models.

Orator is your AI speaking coach for interviews, presentations, pitches, sales calls, wedding toasts, first dates, and everyday confidence.

Practice out loud. Get real-time feedback. Train your voice in 5–10 minutes a day.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH ORATOR

• Get instant feedback on filler words, pace, pitch, clarity, energy, and confidence

• Train with short lessons on breath, articulation, projection, resonance, pacing, and stage presence

• Improve diction with voice drills, tongue twisters, breath exercises, and pronunciation practice

• Prepare for real moments: job interviews, salary conversations, presentations, networking, sales calls, speeches, and difficult conversations

• Build a daily speaking habit with streaks, goals, achievements, and progress tracking

• Expand your vocabulary with Word of the Day, pronunciation support, and speaking prompts

WHY ORATOR

Most of us were never taught how to speak well.

We learned to write essays, solve equations, code apps, and prepare slides — but not how to use the one tool we rely on every day: our voice.

Orator helps you train the mechanics of confident speaking: breath, rhythm, clarity, pace, tone, and vocal presence.

It is not just about what to say.

It is about how you say it.

LIVE AI SCENARIOS

Do not just rehearse a script. Speak with AI characters that listen, respond, and push back in real time.

Practice answering interview questions.
Handle objections in a sales call.
Prepare for a first date.
Respond to a skeptical investor.
Rehearse a wedding toast.
Warm up before a presentation.

The first time you face the real moment does not have to feel like the first time.

REAL-TIME SPEECH ANALYSIS

Record yourself and get feedback on:

• Filler words like “um,” “like,” and “you know”
• Speaking pace
• Pitch range
• Clarity
• Energy
• Confidence
• Vocal habits over time

Track your progress across days, weeks, and months.

SHORT LESSONS. REAL PRACTICE.

Build the foundation of a stronger speaking voice with hundreds of lessons and drills covering:

• Breath control
• Articulation
• Projection
• Resonance
• Pitch
• Pacing
• Stage presence
• Conversational confidence

Train like a musician practices scales or an athlete trains form: one focused skill at a time.

WHO ORATOR IS FOR

Orator is built for:

• Job seekers preparing for interviews
• Professionals preparing for reviews, negotiations, and meetings
• Founders pitching investors
• Leaders preparing for keynotes and board meetings
• Teachers, professors, trainers, and public speakers
• Sales professionals practicing calls and objections
• Students building presentation confidence
• Anyone who freezes when called on, dreads small talk, or wants to sound clearer, calmer, and more confident

PRIVACY & TRUST

Microphone and speech recognition permissions are used to analyze your practice.

Your recordings are used only to support your speaking practice and feedback.

No ads.
No data sold.

Train daily. Speak deliberately. Be heard.

• Images and photo edits: generate images, remove or replace a background, upscale a photo, or mark an area and describe the change

• Logos: original logo ideas for your business, plus variations and a matching icon set

2. Add photos, files or past designs, or share images to Wixel straight from another app and your social networks.

Small business owners, creators, marketers and anyone who needs great-looking content fast, without hiring a designer or learning design software. Wixel is your AI designer for logos, social media posts, videos, brand kits and presentations, all in one chat.

MADE FOR SPEAKING
- Podcast episodes and interviews
- Wedding toasts and best-man speeches
- Conference talks, sermons, lectures, pitches
